name: dsh-web-inspect
description: Element inspector for the DSH (DeepSeek Harness) right-sidebar HTML preview: pick an element and insert its CSS selector, HTML snippet, box and computed styles into the session as a folded reference chip.

capabilities.summary: Enter element-pick mode over the DSH right-sidebar HTML document preview; hover highlights the element and a click inserts its context into the current session input as a folded reference chip. The message is never sent automatically.
not_for: running tests, builds or the app
quoting a passage of text from a conversation
JavaScript runtime, console or network debugging

requires.restart: not required; refresh the page after install
